checks.why: a bound method handed to an executor as a VALUE (`loop.run_in_executor(None, svc.cancel, oid)`) is called by the executor, by no call site the graph sees. Its receiver is typed exactly as `svc.cancel()` would be, so the function that queues it reaches it, labelled as handed over, never as a call
avoid: the two are independent in this graph
